integrity.proof_type: exhaustive literal factor enumeration plus exact rational dual lower certificates and finite poset argument

scientific_limitations: The exact minimum and canonical coverage-base tables are proved only for ten dyadic prefixes of lengths 2 through 1024.
No asymptotic bound, general all-stage recurrence, or complete enumeration of all minimum attractors is claimed.
The original computing run and self-review are not independent scientific validation.
Possible unindexed earlier circular-paperfolding computations remain an originality risk.
title: Exact circular attractors and irredundant coverage bases for ten dyadic paperfolding prefixes
